title: Referee
body:
Why is the player name in that video green? Name colours are now randomly assigned when a world is created, and the colour you start with is based on your username. This uses Minecraft's 'team' system.

To change your name colour (team), make a Referee Block. It lets you switch teams freely.

Teams have no effect on gameplay and are purely cosmetic. You can still hit and collide with players who have the same name colour as you.
